audit_items.proof_trace: The function broadcasts all data column sidecars to all computed subnets without verifying the node is subscribed to those subnets. There is no check of CustodyGroupCount or filtering based on the node's custody columns before calling BroadcastDataColumnSidecar, violating the PeerDAS spec requirement.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A validator building a block with 128 data columns will broadcast to all 128 subnets even if only subscribed to a subset (e.g., 16 subnets based on custody_group_count=1). This allows unauthorized publishing to non-custody subnets, potentially enabling network spam or incorrect DAS assumptions.
